stories.title: «Que peut l’Union européenne pour Ottawa ?» : au Canada et aux États-Unis, la presse prudente sur le statut de «membre associé»

en.title: "What can the European Union do for Ottawa?": In Canada and the United States, the press is cautious about "associate member" status
en.summary: Ursula von der Leyen's proposal to grant Canada associate membership in the European Union is receiving mixed reactions from Canadian and American media outlets, with some viewing it as a reasonable response to Donald Trump and others expressing concerns about sovereignty.

stories.title: «L’Europe et le Canada sont plus forts ensemble» : Mark Carney justifie son projet d’alliance anti-Trump

en.title: "Europe and Canada are stronger together": Mark Carney defends his anti-Trump alliance project
en.summary: The Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney responded to Donald Trump's threats in Strasbourg by outlining his vision for closer ties between Canada and the European Union.

stories.title: A Strasbourg, Mark Carney livre sa vision d’une alliance avec l’Union européenne

en.title: In Strasbourg, Mark Carney outlines his vision of an alliance with the European Union
en.summary: Canada's Prime Minister presented his case for closer cooperation with European countries to the European Parliament on September 17, disregarding threats from U.S. President Donald Trump and highlighting areas for potential collaboration.

stories.title: Riner et l’«angoisse» du RN, Mbappé et le tee-shirt hommage à Ceuta : les deux stars critiquées par l’extrême droite et ses alliés médiatiques

en.title: Riner and the "anxiety" of the RN, Mbappé and the tribute t-shirt to Ceuta: the two stars criticized by the far right and its media allies
en.summary: Two prominent French sports figures have faced harsh criticism from far-right politicians and associated media outlets over their recent public positions.

stories.title: Nestlé sera rejugé pour ses décharges sauvages dans les Vosges après l'annulation du procès qui s'est tenu en mars

en.title: Nestlé to be retried for illegal dumps in the Vosges after March trial cancellation
en.summary: A court of appeal in Nancy has ordered a retrial of Nestlé's case regarding illegal waste disposal, nullifying the proceedings held in March. The case will return to the lower criminal court.

stories.title: Pour le budget 2027, Sébastien Lecornu propose "un effort" d'environ 54 milliards d'euros

en.title: For the 2027 budget, Sébastien Lecornu proposes cost-cutting measures of approximately 54 billion euros
en.summary: The Prime Minister stated that debt servicing is placing increasing strain on the budget equation, proposing roughly 54 billion euros in savings for the 2027 budget.

stories.title: Budget 2027 : Sébastien Lecornu table finalement sur «environ 54 milliards d’euros» d’économies

en.title: 2027 budget: Sébastien Lecornu ultimately targets approximately 54 billion euros in savings
en.summary: The Prime Minister outlined budgetary savings targets of around 54 billion euros ahead of the 2027 finance bill presentation, discussing potential cost-cutting measures in an interview.

stories.title: Prix des carburants : les pêcheurs lèvent les blocages du port de Nice et d’un dépôt pétrolier dans l’Hérault

en.title: Fuel prices: fishermen lift blockades at Nice port and oil depot in Hérault
en.summary: Fishermen ended blockades at Nice port and a petroleum facility in Hérault following a meeting with the maritime minister, though no concrete agreements were reached. Further blockades at Marseille and Toulon are being considered.

stories.title: Canada - Union Européenne : "plus forts ensemble" d'après le premier ministre canadien

en.title: Canada - European Union: "stronger together" according to Canadian Prime Minister
en.summary: The European Commission President proposed that Canada become the EU's first associated member state. Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney responded positively to this proposal, with officials clarifying it is not an anti-American alliance.

stories.title: "Nous sommes plus forts ensemble" : le Canada salue l'idée de devenir membre associé de l'Union européenne

en.title: "We are stronger together": Canada welcomes the idea of becoming an associated member of the European Union
en.summary: The European Commission President proposed that Canada strengthen its ties with the EU through a new associated member status. The proposal was made on Wednesday.

stories.title: Mark Carney devant le Parlement européen : «Le Canada accueille favorablement la proposition d’être membre associé de l’UE»

en.title: Mark Carney before the European Parliament: "Canada welcomes favorably the proposal to become an associated member of the EU"
en.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney addressed the European Parliament in Strasbourg the day after the European Commission President proposed Canada become an associated EU member.

stories.title: Ukraine, Turquie, Serbie et désormais Canada… Quels sont les liens de l’Union européenne avec ses voisins ?

en.title: Ukraine, Turkey, Serbia and now Canada... What are the European Union's links with its neighbors?
en.summary: The European Commission President proposed Canada become the EU's first associated member state, expanding Europe's geographic framework. The EU maintains varying relationships with multiple neighboring entities.

stories.title: Sentinel-3 : vingt ans d'observation pour anticiper le climat de demain

en.title: Sentinel-3: twenty years of observation to anticipate tomorrow's climate
en.summary: The European Sentinel 3C satellite was launched into orbit by Vega-C to support climate monitoring and forecasting efforts.

stories.title: La Malaisie se penche sur l’épineux cas AirAsia

en.title: Malaysia examines the thorny AirAsia case
en.summary: AirAsia, which dominates Malaysian aviation with 40% market share and 60% of domestic routes, faces severe financial difficulties as the government develops contingency plans.

stories.title: Air Baltic demande son placement sous Chapitre 11 mais reste au-dessus de l’eau

en.title: Air Baltic seeks Chapter 11 protection but stays afloat
en.summary: Latvia's national airline filed for Chapter 11 bankruptcy protection on September 14 and subsequently secured approval to access 140 million euros from a 350 million euro financing package to continue operations.

stories.title: Dans les coulisses de l’usine bordelaise de Ouidrop qui équipe les drives de la grande distribution

en.title: Behind the scenes at Ouidrop's Bordeaux factory equipping retail drive-throughs
en.summary: Ouidrop opened a new assembly plant near Bordeaux to manufacture temperature-controlled robotic lockers for retail drive-throughs, currently serving twenty supermarket locations including E. Leclerc, Coopérative U, and Intermarché.

stories.title: Pendant que la France continue d'emprunter à des niveaux alarmants, l'Espagne ramène sa dette sous les 100% du PIB

en.title: While France continues borrowing at alarming levels, Spain brings its debt below 100% of GDP
en.summary: France is borrowing at record rates while Spain has reduced its public debt below 100 percent of GDP, demonstrating contrasting fiscal performance between the two nations.
